text: Company came to XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX for a promotion cameras people everywhere signed up gave them all my information SNAP card and all was told to go to XXXX office to pick up my cable box also was told it would be {$9.00} a month but I would not have to pay because Affordable Connectivity Program, start getting a bill went to XXXX store on XXXX three ( 3 ) times to get this situation straighten out even ask to speak with a manager was told not available he would call me back was told don't worry it would be taken care of meaning my bill never got a call back have sent them emails no respond will get an email asking me to bring my old cable box in to get a new one because I had stopped using it because it was not working. Months later account sent to collections
